title: Fix OperatorInfo.module Field Regression In Imperative-Text
description: Fix compile failure in semio-s-plugin-imperative-text where OperatorInfo.module was accessed despite OperatorInfo using extension field.
summary: Fixed regression in ✏️s/🔌️plugin/📜️imperative/🧩️extension/📝️text/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs where info.module was referenced on OperatorInfo instead of info.extension. Updated line 79 to use info.extension. Verified cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 -p semio-s-plugin-sequence and cargo test -p semio-s-plugin-imperative-text compile and pass clean.
